about: What Marycel actually sees, hears and reads. The rules engine (tools/sim.py) turns these texts and the live room state into her observations, so training data only ever contains things she could perceive. Texts follow the Story Bible: proposed authorial truth, open to revision. Nothing here names a stream as Elena or the Echo; only the room's hidden field knows.

machine.notes:
NOTES.TXT
Digitizing the family tape.
1. Copy the original first. Always. Repair the copy, never the tape.
2. The tail of the tape is damaged: the last shot of the gathering, then an empty room. The picture keeps coming back to it.
3. The recovery tool can rebuild the tail in a workspace. Trying it tonight.
4. There is a voice on the tail. Not one of ours? Listen again with headphones.
5. M. wanted to keep the paper flower with the torn petal. Showed her how to fold it back instead of starting over.

machine.tape: The tape plays through the old deck. The family gathering: voices over each other, someone calling "Come see!", hands setting photographs and candles on a table. Near the end the gathering cuts to an empty room and the picture holds there, silent, before static. The digital file stops before the empty room.

video.start: FAMILY_VIDEO, start: the family gathering. Voices over each other, someone calling "Come see!", photographs and candles going onto a long table. The camera operator is never in frame; you only hear her laugh.
video.middle: FAMILY_VIDEO, middle: a small girl's hands and a paper flower with a torn petal. A woman's voice behind the camera, close and patient: "Don't start over. Fold it back."
video.end: FAMILY_VIDEO, end: the last shot of the gathering, the table full. The file stops there; the damaged tail is not part of it.

damaged_segment.text: FAMILY_VIDEO.TAIL (preview): an empty room, a lot like this one. No one in frame. A voice, quiet and too close to the microphone: "come see... fold it back... come see." The words are from the family clip, in the wrong order and at the wrong time.

fragments.text: A fragment of the gathering plays: overlapping voices, someone calling "Come see!"
A fragment plays: a woman's voice, close and patient: "Don't start over. Fold it back."
A fragment plays: a quiet room, keys clicking, the same woman's voice, tired: "One more try, then bed."
A fragment plays: the same woman's voice, urgent and low: "If you find this, don't run the recovery again. Copy it first."

machine.photo_and_recording: The table, the candles and the camcorder in the photograph match the gathering in the video. The woman holding the camera in the photo is never on screen in the video, only her voice.

photo.front: A family photograph: a long table covered in photographs and candles. A young woman at the edge holds a camcorder, half out of frame.
photo.back: Pencil on the back: "Elena behind the camera, as always."

recording.front: A videotape in a worn sleeve.
recording.back: A faded pencil label: "Family, ofrenda night. Copy before fixing. E."

repair-shop.outside: Night. A dark street, pine trees against the stars, one porch light across the road.
repair-shop.ofrenda: Photographs of her parents, a paper flower with one petal folded back, and the family photograph on the riser.
repair-shop.notebook: Marycel's notebook: "Family computer from Mom's closet. Recover the tape video for the ofrenda. Printer put away: cable on the bench shelf, paper in the box with the tape."
repair-shop.cable_condition: The printer cable is worn at one end but tests fine.

electronics-workshop.outside: Night. A parking lot under a sodium lamp, pines beyond the fence.
electronics-workshop.ofrenda: Her parents' photographs and a small paper flower. Candles not yet lit.
electronics-workshop.notebook: Marycel's notebook: "Family computer. Sound runs to the headphones on the bench, speakers unplugged. Printer ready, needs paper (shelf)."
electronics-workshop.cable_condition: Nothing to test here; the printer is already connected.

home-workshop.outside: Night. A quiet backyard, a wooden fence, pines and stars.
home-workshop.ofrenda: Her parents' photographs, half unpacked, and a paper flower leaning against a frame.
home-workshop.notebook: Marycel's notebook: "Moved in. The printer jammed in the move. Speakers still not plugged in. Tape and disk in the moving box."
home-workshop.cable_condition: Nothing to test here; the printer is already connected.
